name: Dana Osei
bio: Dana spent eight years writing backend Python at scale-ups before moving to full-time teaching. She focuses on getting students comfortable reading their own tracebacks before they write a single design pattern.

name: Marcus Feldman
bio: Marcus is a staff engineer who has sat on both sides of over 200 system design interviews. He teaches trade-off thinking first, diagrams second.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Priya bridges both tracks, helping students connect the Python they write to the systems it eventually has to run inside of.
credentials: Built and scaled a Django monolith to microservices
